events.n: offered the front cover and lead story of Life, about the Fort Peck Dam in Montana
events.q: In 1936, Time Inc. Editor-In-Chief Henry Luce, with whom Bourke-White worked frequently, called on the thirty-two-year-old photographer to join him on his new magazine, *Life.* He offered her the front cover and lead story–about the Fort Peck Dam in Montana–and a position as one of only four staff photographers.
